title: Grateful Dead Live at William and Mary College Hall on 1978-04-15
lineage: (original) Nak 550 Dolby B on> Apogee Mini-Me @ 16/44> wav; Assembly: AA3 for fades and edits, CDWav for tracks, TLH for Flac7, Foobar for tags; Recorded by Mark Olkon; Transferred and Assembled by Mike Schuncke
source: flac16 Source: (single) Nakamichi CM300 with CP1 cardioid capsule front of board> Nakamichi 550 deck with dolby B on;

ai_review.summary: Excellent mono audience recording captures a high‑energy spring ’78 show with standout Powerhouse 1/2 Step, LIG and a rare Dew.
ai_review.review: The single‑mic audience tape delivers surprisingly clear, direct sound that many reviewers say beats a poor stereo source. The concert itself is described as one of the best shows, full of power‑filled jams like “Powerhouse 1/2 Step,” “LIG,” and a rare rendition of “Dew.” Overall the performance and recording are both praised highly.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are strongly positive, highlighting both superb sound quality for a one‑mic audience source and an outstanding live performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono recording with a single mic captures direct sound; reviewers note it is clearer than many bad stereo recordings. Some mention a matrix but overall the tape is praised for its clarity and presence.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is described as a high‑energy, party‑like performance with the crowd feeding the band, resulting in powerful jams and a memorable overall flow.
